# Text, motion and expressions

Text presets, enter and exit presets, eases, expressions and the sound kit.

## Text presets

`rise`, `reveal`, `rise_words`, `fade_up`, `blur_in`, `pop`, `slam`, `drop`, `typewriter`, `scramble`, `tracking_in`, `wave_in`, `spin_in`, `elastic`, `fade_out`, `rise_out`

## Enter and exit presets

| preset | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `fade` | opacity only |
| `slide_up` | rises into place from `dist` px below |
| `slide_down` | drops into place from `dist` px above |
| `slide_left` | slides in from the right |
| `slide_right` | slides in from the left |
| `pop` | scales up from 60 % with a small overshoot |
| `zoom_in` | settles from 130 % to 100 % |
| `zoom_out` | settles from 70 % to 100 % |
| `blur` | resolves from a blur of `blur` px |
| `whip_left` | a fast horizontal whip with motion smear, from the right |
| `whip_right` | a fast horizontal whip with motion smear, from the left |
| `spin` | turns 90 degrees into place while fading |
| `drop` | falls in from above and bounces |
| `stamp` | lands oversized and rotated, like a rubber stamp |
| `toss` | flies off on a short arc, rotating (GSAP Inertia) |
| `wipe_left` | a clip opens from the left (GSAP clipPath) |
| `wipe_right` | a clip opens from the right |
| `wipe_up` | a clip opens from the bottom |
| `wipe_down` | a clip opens from the top |
| `iris` | a circle opens from the centre |
| `tumble` | a fast 3D-feeling spin: rotates, overshoots scale, smears |
| `push_left` | shot transition: the whole frame travels left; enter comes from the right, exit leaves to the left |
| `push_right` | shot transition: the frame travels right |
| `push_up` | shot transition: the frame travels up |
| `push_down` | shot transition: the frame travels down |
| `whip_pan_left` | shot transition: a camera whip pan to the left, motion smear peaking mid-move |
| `whip_pan_right` | shot transition: a camera whip pan to the right |
| `pan_out_left` | shot transition: the camera pulls back until both shots are tiles on one canvas, pans left, pushes into the next |
| `pan_out_right` | shot transition: pull back, pan right, push in |
| `pan_out_up` | shot transition: pull back, pan up, push in |
| `pan_out_down` | shot transition: pull back, pan down, push in |
| `zoom_through` | shot transition: fly forward through the outgoing shot into the next (exit grows past the lens, enter grows to fill) |
| `zoom_back` | shot transition: fly backward (exit shrinks away, enter arrives from in front of the lens) |
| `cross_zoom` | shot transition: a constant-speed dolly; both shots zoom at one rate, so there is no jump in speed where one hands over to the other |
| `window` | shot transition: the next shot is a rounded card (`portal`, `radius`) that grows to fill the frame while the last zooms toward it |
| `blur_dissolve` | shot transition: a dissolve through a soft blur |
| `glitch` | shot transition: jittering slices of horizontal smear and a hard flicker |
| `recede` | shot transition, outgoing only: steps back and dims while the next shot slides over it |

## Eases

`none`, `power1.in/out/inOut`, `power2.*`, `power3.*`, `power4.*`, `sine.*`, `expo.*`, `circ.*`, `back.*(overshoot)`, `elastic.*(amplitude, period)`, `bounce.*`, `steps(n)`, `cubic(x1, y1, x2, y2)`, `spring(damping_ratio)`, `smooth`, `wiggle(n)`, `rough(strength, points, seed)`, `slow(ratio, power)`, `hold`

## Time literals

`1.5s`, `45f`, `beat:8`, `bar:2`, `marker:drop`, `title.end`, `title.start`, `prev.end`, `comp.end`, `any of those followed by +0.25 or -3f`

## Colour forms

`#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `#rgb`, `white`, `accent (a palette token)`

## Expressions

* **layers**: `ref("layer id", "x|y|z|rotation|opacity|scale|sx|sy")`, `vel("layer id", "x|y|z|rotation|opacity|scale|sx|sy") units per second`
* **math**: `sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `asin`, `acos`, `atan`, `atan2`, `abs`, `min`, `max`, `floor`, `ceil`, `round`, `sqrt`, `pow`, `exp`, `ln`, `sign`, `fract`, `mod`, `step`, `pingpong`, `clamp(x, lo, hi)`, `lerp(a, b, t)`, `radians`, `degrees`
* **motion**: `linear(x, x0, x1, y0, y1)`, `smooth(x0, x1, x)`, `ease("expo.out", x, x0, x1, y0, y1)`, `wiggle(freq, amp, octaves?)`, `noise(x)`, `noise2(x, y)`, `random(seed)`
* **operators**: + - * / % ^ == != < <= > >= && || ! and a ? b : c
* **rhythm**: `beat() 0..1 within the beat`, `bar() 0..1 within the bar`, `beat_index()`, `marker("name") seconds since the marker`, `amp("audio layer id") loudness 0..1`, `onset("audio layer id") seconds since the latest kick or hit`
* **variables**: `time (layer seconds)`, `comp_time`, `value (the keyframed value)`, `index`, `fps`, `frame`, `width`, `height`, `dur`, `progress (0..1 of the layer's life)`, `bpm`, `pi`, `tau`

## Sound kit

| cue | timbre |
| --- | --- |
| `bass` | round sub bass with a saw edge (pitched: use pluck/C4 ... notes) |
| `bell` | inharmonic struck bell with an FM glint (pitched: use pluck/C4 ... notes) |
| `clap` | hand claps |
| `downer` | falls away: plunges, closing filters, tape stop |
| `glitch` | digital stutters, chirps and data bursts |
| `hat` | hi-hats: closed, open, pedal |
| `impact` | hits: sub booms, punches, struck metal, wood, glass and cinematic slams |
| `key` | keyboard keys (each different), space, enter and mouse clicks |
| `kick` | kick drums: 808, punchy, soft, techno, sub, distorted |
| `marimba` | tuned wooden bar (pitched: use pluck/C4 ... notes) |
| `mech` | camera shutters, servos, switches, ratchets and clock ticks |
| `paper` | paper rustles, cloth brushes, page flips, crumples and tears |
| `pluck` | Karplus-Strong plucked string (pitched: use pluck/C4 ... notes) |
| `pop` | bubbles, lip pops, water plops |
| `rim` | rim shots, side-sticks and clave |
| `riser` | builds to a moment: noise, tonal, Shepard, pulses |
| `shimmer` | sparkle clouds, glints, shimmering beds and harp glissandi |
| `snare` | snares: tight, fat, electro, snappy, brush, gated |
| `stab` | detuned saw stab with a closing filter (pitched: use pluck/C4 ... notes) |
| `stinger` | tonal chord hits in C minor (cmin) and F major (fmaj) |
| `sweep` | long filter passes: noise, tonal, flanged, radio |
| `swell` | pads, strings, choir and cymbal blooms |
| `swish` | fast whips and cloth flicks |
| `tom` | toms from floor to high |
| `ui` | interface clicks, taps, toggles, hovers, notifications, success and error |
| `whoosh` | air moving past: short, bright, dark, long, airy and reversed |
| `boom` | a pool: impact/sub, impact/cine |
| `card-in` | a pool: swish/flick, paper/flip |
| `click` | a pool: ui/click, key/mouse |
| `counter` | a pool: ui/notify, shimmer/glint |
| `fast-pass` | a pool: whoosh/short, whoosh/bright, swish/flick |
| `heavy-pass` | a pool: whoosh/dark, whoosh/long, downer/noise |
| `loss` | a pool: downer/drop, impact/sub |
| `pull-back` | a pool: whoosh/reverse, downer/noise, sweep/noise-down |
| `reveal` | a pool: shimmer/sparkle, shimmer/shimmer, swell/cymbal |
| `soft-pass` | a pool: whoosh/airy, whoosh/long, paper/cloth |
| `stamp` | a pool: impact/punch, impact/wood |
| `tick` | a pool: mech/tick |
| `type` | a pool: key/key |
| `wipe-pass` | a pool: swish/whip, whoosh/bright, paper/flip |
